title: Lunch at School
text:
I eat lunch at school every day. The food is hot and good. Today there is soup and bread. I like the soup very much.

Our teacher eats lunch with us. The rice is also good. After lunch, we play in the garden. Then we go back to class.

questions.text: What is there for lunch today?
Where do the children play after lunch?
How does the narrator probably feel about lunch?
options: They do not like the food at all.

questions.text: What can we tell about the school day?
options: Lunch is part of the school day.
Students do not go to class.

vocabulary.definition: the meal eaten in the middle of the day
a piece of land where plants, flowers, or trees grow
a hot liquid food made with vegetables, meat, or other ingredients
a room in a school where students learn

paragraph_translations: Her gün okulda öğle yemeği yerim. Yemek sıcak ve güzel. Bugün çorba ve ekmek var. Çorbayı çok severim.
Öğretmenimiz bizimle öğle yemeği yer. Pilav da güzel. Öğle yemeğinden sonra bahçede oynarız. Sonra sınıfa geri döneriz.
